newsitem.title: USA: Court lets cities in Washington state collect tax.
newsitem.headline: Court lets cities in Washington state collect tax.

text.p: A Superior Court judge issued an order on Friday allowing the cities of Bellevue and Yakima, Washington, to continue collecting the current hotel-motel tax, the governor's office said.
The ability of the cities to collect the tax was in question after Washington state Gov. Gary Locke vetoed sections of a hotel-motel tax bill at the urging of cities and the hotel-motel industry.
Locke's office said Superior Court Judge Richard Strophy's ruling would allow the two cities to continue to collect the tax to support their convention centers.
"I'm pleased we could resolve this situation through a quick legal solution," Locke said in a statement.
